info.name: Get carbon intensity statistics for a date/time range

params.name: from
params.description: Start datetime in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ). Example: 2018-01-20T12:00Z

params.name: to
params.description: End datetime in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ). Example: 2018-01-20T12:30Z

items.docs: Returns aggregated carbon intensity statistics (min, max, average) for the specified date/time range.

info.name: Get blocked carbon intensity statistics for a date/time range

params.name: from
params.description: Start datetime in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ). Example: 2018-01-20T12:00Z

params.name: to
params.description: End datetime in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ). Example: 2018-01-20T12:30Z

items.docs: Returns aggregated carbon intensity statistics (min, max, average) for the specified date/time range, grouped into blocks of the specified number of hours.
